summary_paragraph: Mr. ___, a male with relapsed multiple myeloma, chronic hemolytic anemia, type 2 diabetes, and CKD stage 3, was admitted for a nasal skin lesion concerning for MRSA infection. He had no systemic symptoms, and cultures were negative. He received IV vancomycin initially, then was switched to oral linezolid and Bactroban ointment for a 5-day course. Chemotherapy was held during the admission. He remained stable, with no fever or progression of infection, and was discharged home with instructions to complete antibiotics and follow up with oncology. His chronic conditions, including heart failure, diabetes, and anemia, remained stable.
